crossCutting.since: 6d897da (merge of feat/reuse-notes 5d92879, Khuram's decision 26/10: ships with this release)
crossCutting.rule: A report made from an earlier report's notes ("Complete another form for this patient") goes through the same report factory as a new one (generate.ts createTargetReport -> core/report-factory.ts createFormReport / createReport) and gets everything a new report gets: the approver (W0.6 plumbing, WC picker), conditions frozen at creation in section.condition and the issue state (WA1), and model 2 (W0.6). No reuse-only creation path. The reuse endpoint stays tenant-scoped (the clinic's own store, id only) and consent is never carried over (core/reuse.ts recordForAnotherForm).
